column1: # Cases for the differential test. Columns: timezone, base time, expression.
# Regenerate tests/fixtures/expected.tsv with: oracle/run.sh < tests/fixtures/cases.tsv > tests/fixtures/expected.tsv
# Local time zone other than UTC
# Whitespace: runs between elements pass, leading, trailing and before the zone fail
# List limit: 241 items per numeric field pass, 242 fail; weekday lists have no limit
# Years: 1970..2199, two-digit years, three digits fail
# Repetition: v/r needs r >= 1 and v + r <= the field maximum; * stands alone
# Day counted from the month's end (~)
# Day from the end: item i of the sorted list may reach at most 28 - 3i
# Duplicates are removed and items sorted; overlapping items are kept
# Range ends shrink to the last value reached; a one-value range becomes a value
# Daylight saving: New York gap 2026-03-08 02:00-03:00 EST, fold 2026-11-01 01:00-02:00
# 1us before a fold: the search starts at the wall clock of base + 1us, inside the repeated hour
# Time zone names: UTC in any case and exact IANA names pass
# Microseconds: systemd prints seconds, so moving the base time pins the fraction
# systemd gives up: it parses, then stops searching (unresolved); the real answer is never
# Day from the end: the limit falls by 3 per item, counted after sorting, deduplication and end shrinking
# Seconds: a range without a repetition needs two whole-second values; v/r needs v + r below 60
# 0/1 turns the whole seconds component into *, and no other field
# Grammar: weekday spellings, weekday ranges, a trailing comma, signs, shorthands
# Two-digit years expand by value in ranges, lists and repetition starts, not in steps
